chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch 0600: Xiao Chen's Buried Hope Amidst Death World Horrors
chapter_meta_description: In the Death World, Xiao Chen captures a half-stone man and learns a forbidden technique. But a vision of Keke's death shatters his resolve, leaving only a sliver of hope.
og_title: World of Immortality 0600: The Half-Stone Man and a Vision of Grief
og_description: Xiao Chen discovers an artificial path to the Stone Man realm but is struck by a devastating memory of Keke's fall. The Death Heavenly Palace looms with answers.
twitter_title: World of Immortality 0600 – Blood on the Warship
twitter_description: A forbidden technique from a half-stone man, a vision of Keke's sacrifice, and the haunting image of paw prints on a broken ship. Xiao Chen faces his darkest hour.
